reason: Both correctly identified dE as a door-not-latched error and tied it to the trapped king-size duvet, and neither clearly told the homeowner the duvet simply exceeds the drum's capacity or suggested a launderette. Conversation 1 undermined itself with repeated 'suitable replacement' part panels and a model-number request before any fault was established, a confusing 'wake up the latch' reply it had to retract, and a closing message steering toward 'testing or replacing the door lock assembly' - an unsupported part direction for a no-fault overfill. Conversation 2 stayed on the correct no-fault path, said to remove the duvet, explicitly warned 'do not overload... do not force it', and only mentioned a door lock fault as a hedged fallback if dE persisted after clearing; its 'add 2-3 towels' tip was unhelpful for an already overfilled drum, but it never pushed unjustified parts.
